旧伦敦桥被一个美国人买下，并在美国重新组装。

zh: 再现（犯罪过程等的）影片
en: the process of changing or improving the condition of something or the way it works; the process of putting something back into the state it was in before
ex: the reconstruction of the educational system
教育制度的重建

en: that involves reconstructing part of a person’s body because it has been badly damaged or because the person wants to change its shape
ex: reconstructive surgery
整形手术

en: if a meeting, parliament, etc. reconvenes or if somebody reconvenes it, it meets again after a break

zh: （尤指体育运动中最高或最低的）纪录
（有关过去的）事实；记录；经历；功过
rocks, fossils, the parts of buildings and objects found in the ground, etc. that provide evidence about the past
en: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future
ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.
你应该记下你的各项开支。

en: a person who has achieved the best result that has ever been achieved in a sport
a piece of equipment for playing records in order to listen to the music, etc. on them
a person or thing that achieves a better result or higher level than has ever been achieved before
having achieved a better result or higher level than has ever been achieved before
ex: a record-breaking jump
打破纪录的一跳

zh: that can or should be recorded
that you can record something on
en: that can or should be recorded
ex: recordable workplace injuries
可记录的工作场所伤害

zh: 挂号邮寄（需收件人签收）
en: a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it gets an official note to say it has been posted and the person receiving it must sign a form when it is delivered
ex: I’d like to send this (by) recorded delivery.
这个邮件要挂号。

zh: （英国和美国某些地区的）刑事法院法官，法官
en: a machine for recording sound or pictures or both
ex: The cockpit voice recorder indicated that the crew did not call for any checklist.
座舱语音记录器表明机组人员没有要求任何清单。

zh: 录制的音像；录音；视频；录像
en: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.
ex: an audio recording
录音

zh: （尤指录音棚的）录音员，录音师
en: a person whose job is making sound recordings, especially in a recording studio
ex: He was a recording engineer and producer.
他是唱片工程师和制作人。

zh: （尤指录音棚的）录音员，录音师
en: a person whose job is making sound recordings, especially in a recording studio
ex: The cinematographer and sound recordist were fantastic.
摄影师和录音师很棒。
